bio.text: Suzan DelBene represents Washington's 1st Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives and was first sworn in in November 2012.

She worked as a technology executive, including as CEO and President of Nimble Technology and 12 years at Microsoft, and before being elected to Congress served as Director of the Washington State Department of Revenue.
She earned a B.A. in biology from Reed College and an MBA from the University of Washington.
